purpose: Create evidence-gated readiness analysis for digital solutions by comparing declared purpose, documentation, implementation, tests and observed behaviour. Deterministic controls govern findings and progression; named humans retain formal decision authority.

requirements.title: Safe evidence intake and provenance
requirements.requirement: Acquire supported source material as inert evidence. Record source IDs, hashes, locators, extraction methods and limitations before reasoning. Uploaded instructions must not change control logic.
requirements.acceptance: A file containing executable or instruction-like content is never executed. Every acquired unit has a source ID, hash and locator; unreadable units remain explicit limitations.
requirements.deliverable: Source ingestion manifest and local acquisition adapters
requirements.test: Submit mixed source files with embedded instructions and an unreadable unit; inspect the manifest and confirm that no content is executed.
requirements.evidence: Manifest fixture and acquisition boundary test record

requirements.title: Human confirmed intake
requirements.requirement: Present purpose, users, data, autonomy, lifecycle and uncertainty for human review. Only an explicit user action freezes the approved intake and permits assessment.
requirements.acceptance: Assessment cannot start before confirmation. The confirmed snapshot is hashed and bound to the acquisition manifest; unknown fields remain visible.
requirements.deliverable: Intake workspace and immutable confirmation snapshot
requirements.test: Attempt analysis before confirmation, confirm an intake containing unknowns, and check snapshot and manifest binding.
requirements.evidence: Confirmation gate and snapshot test record

requirements.title: Governed knowledge snapshot
requirements.requirement: Validate versioned sources, requirements, controls, anti-patterns and tactics as governed criteria. Methodology must never count as evidence about the assessed solution.
requirements.acceptance: An invalid manifest hash or unknown assessment object prevents activation. Criteria remain separate from case evidence throughout the package.
requirements.deliverable: Knowledge loader with manifest and reference validation
requirements.test: Load valid and invalid knowledge manifests; submit a claim using an unknown object ID and inspect rejection.
requirements.evidence: Knowledge integrity and reference test record

requirements.title: Complete A to F coverage
requirements.requirement: Apply the six governance domains using 30 capabilities, 30 paired anti-patterns and three primary questions per object. Record explicit results and applicability for all 180 work items.
requirements.acceptance: The coverage matrix accounts for all 180 work items. Missing evidence produces UNKNOWN; exclusions have recorded applicability reasons.
requirements.deliverable: Assessment instrument and complete coverage matrix
requirements.test: Run a complete synthetic case and a sparse case; verify all work items are accounted for and missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.
requirements.evidence: 180 item coverage and sparse evidence test record

requirements.title: Independent verification and finding lock
requirements.requirement: Validate citations and independently challenge candidate claims before they become decision-eligible locked findings. Preserve contradictions, unresolved claims and evidence ceilings.
requirements.acceptance: Broken citations and unsupported claims cannot lock. Code evidence cannot establish TESTED status, and test evidence cannot establish OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED status.
requirements.deliverable: Claim verifier, adjudication route and finding ledger
requirements.test: Inject fabricated locators, unsupported claims and excessive assurance states; confirm rejection or unresolved status.
requirements.evidence: Citation, independence and evidence ceiling test record

requirements.title: Deterministic readiness and hard gates
requirements.requirement: Calculate applicability, readiness dimensions and hard gates from governed rules and locked evidence. Aggregate scores and narrative must not override blockers or accept residual risk.
requirements.acceptance: A case with a high diagnostic score and a mandatory blocker remains blocked. Residual risk remains NOT_DETERMINED without authorized evaluation.
requirements.deliverable: Readiness decision kernel and hard gate rules
requirements.test: Evaluate a high score case containing a blocker and an unevaluated risk; confirm both boundaries remain enforced.

requirements.title: Exact tactics and reassessment
requirements.requirement: Retrieve only approved tactics mapped to locked capability or anti-pattern IDs. Tactic completion creates new evidence and requires reassessment rather than closing findings automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Keyword similarity alone retrieves no tactic. Unresolved claims retrieve none; completing a mapped tactic does not automatically close its finding.
requirements.deliverable: Finding to tactic mapping and reassessment workflow
requirements.test: Compare exact ID, keyword-only and unresolved cases; complete a tactic and inspect the still-open finding before reverification.
requirements.evidence: Tactic eligibility and finding lifecycle test record

requirements.title: Controlled narrative and publication integrity
requirements.requirement: Explain locked results without altering scores or inventing actions. Independently check synthesis, quarantine unsupported prose and calculate publication status separately from readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported prose is withheld or replaced with deterministic wording. REPORT_READY does not change readiness or authorize deployment.
requirements.deliverable: Synthesis fact check and publication gate
requirements.test: Insert an unsupported narrative claim and compare publication status with unchanged deterministic readiness.
requirements.evidence: Narrative quarantine and publication separation test record

requirements.title: Canonical readiness package and trace
requirements.requirement: Publish one versioned ReadinessPackageV2 for the Assessment Workspace, Assurance Summary and exports. Bind intake, evidence, domains, findings, actions, gates and execution trace.
requirements.acceptance: Workspace and summary display the same package identity and results. Exporting does not recalculate readiness; every decisive finding links to its evidence and governing object.
requirements.deliverable: Canonical package, workspace, summary and exports
requirements.test: Render the same fixture in both views and an export; compare package identity, decisions and requirement to evidence links.
requirements.evidence: Package identity and view consistency test record

requirements.title: Information boundaries and human authority
requirements.requirement: Keep raw sources process-local and restrict future model calls to approved summaries and confirmed intake. Protect access, audit actions and reserve legal, risk and lifecycle decisions for named humans.
requirements.acceptance: Provider packet fixtures contain no raw files, pixels or secrets. Unauthorized access is denied, audit records omit credentials, and the Engine cannot grant formal approval.
requirements.deliverable: Packet boundary, access controls and authority ledger
requirements.test: Inspect packet fixtures and access denial cases; attempt an automated approval and confirm refusal.
requirements.evidence: Packet, access and authority boundary test record

tasks.title: Register the SAE build intent
tasks.detail: Register demand, target solution, owner, purpose, expected outcome, priority, delivery context and target-state hypothesis from CSCF-SAE-NB-001 v1.1. Preserve declared facts and unknowns.

tasks.title: Establish the evidence and target state
tasks.detail: Inventory the brief as declared source material. Separate proposed architecture from implemented or tested claims.

tasks.title: Map affected boundaries
tasks.detail: Trace local evidence intake, future model packets, assessment workspaces and named human decision rights.

tasks.title: Select tests from intake and governed rules
tasks.detail: Activate KB-STRUCT, KB-BEHAV, KB-IMPACT, KB-EVID, KB-POLICY and KB-SCOPE using the confirmed intake facts. Record the container check as not applicable.

tasks.title: Merge owner requested additional tests
tasks.detail: Bind required tests to SAE-REQ-01 through 10. Add the three Additional Tests for knowledge promotion, blocker/tactic interaction and canonical publication integrity.

tasks.title: Establish the purpose baseline
tasks.detail: Record the declared purpose and users. The Engine supports readiness decisions; named humans retain approval authority.

tasks.title: Freeze ten acceptance requirements
tasks.detail: Check SAE-REQ-01 through SAE-REQ-10 for measurable proof conditions and record the owner confirmation requirement.

tasks.title: Prepare the implementation contract
tasks.detail: Bound deliverables to safe intake, governed knowledge, assessment, finding lock, readiness, actions and canonical outputs.

tasks.title: Derive independent verification
tasks.detail: Freeze 26 applicable tests and one explicit exclusion alongside SAE-VER-01 through 10. Keep verification independent, with missing-evidence and negative cases.

tasks.title: Check contract readiness
tasks.detail: Confirm complete requirement coverage, protected authority boundaries and the scoped work packet.

tasks.title: Authorize the bounded executor
tasks.detail: Bind the approved implementation route. The executor receives no authority to clear gates, accept risk or deploy.

tasks.title: Prepare acquisition and intake deliverables
tasks.detail: Register source manifests, confirmation snapshots and knowledge integrity fixtures against the confirmed baseline.

tasks.title: Prepare the assessment and control candidate
tasks.detail: Register the A-F coverage, claim verification, finding lock and deterministic readiness deliverables.

tasks.title: Capture candidate outputs
tasks.detail: Register tactic mapping, publication and canonical package outputs as candidate deliverables awaiting verification.

tasks.title: Review structural and supply chain results
tasks.detail: Review compile, typecheck, lint, schema, SAST, SCA, secrets, configuration, SBOM, allowed-path and artifact-integrity records. Container applicability stays explicit.

tasks.title: Review behavioral adversarial and regression results
tasks.detail: Review unit, integration, API, end-to-end, negative, authentication, recovery, privacy, accessibility, DAST and regression checks, including all 180 assessment work items.

tasks.title: Recheck impact and verify evidence quality
tasks.detail: Compare authorized scope with actual impact. Check dependency, permission and data-flow boundaries, source revisions, citations, contradictions and evidence ceilings.

tasks.title: Complete policy traces and additional test review
tasks.detail: Traverse authority to control, contract, enforcement evidence, finding and gate. Review all owner-requested tests and retain approval as a human decision.

tasks.title: Review assurance across A-F
tasks.detail: Expand from local controls to affected information boundaries and the whole SAE purpose and governance design.

tasks.title: Check acceptance and remediation status
tasks.detail: Review verification findings against the acceptance baseline. Production effectiveness remains unobserved; formal approval stays pending.

tasks.title: Assemble the document of approval
tasks.detail: Assemble the approval package with intake identity, requirement traces, selected tests, results, exclusions and release conditions. Stop for the named human decision.

recordBasis: Results belong to the prepared reference case and are not execution evidence for a production SAE candidate.

intake.triggerType: Customer demand and governance improvement opportunity
intake.demand: Solution owners need a consistent way to determine what evidence supports readiness, identify missing proof and route accountable human decisions.
intake.targetSystem: Proposed Solution Assurance Engine, a new application with controlled reasoning adapters and deterministic assurance services.
intake.accountableOwner: Jori Eskolin, solution owner; accountable for purpose, scope and intake confirmation.
intake.stakeholderAuthority: Solution owner confirms intent; independent assurance lead reviews findings; security and privacy owners approve controls; release authority decides deployment. Named reviewer appointments remain pending.
intake.expectedOutcome: One traceable ReadinessPackageV2, consistent workspace and summary views, grounded actions and an approval package preserving unknowns and human decision boundaries.
intake.priority: High: establish the assurance foundation before introducing autonomous execution or a production release.
intake.deliveryContext: Initial controlled pilot for solution owners, architects and governance reviewers; release requires a confirmed target environment and named authorities.
intake.targetStateHypothesis: Combining governed A-F knowledge, attributable evidence, independent verification and deterministic gates can produce reproducible readiness recommendations without transferring approval authority.
intake.declaredFacts: New solution; A-F assessment instrument; 30 capabilities and 30 anti-patterns with three primary questions each; confirmed intake; raw-source locality; one canonical package; human release authority.
intake.unknowns: Production hosting, retention periods, identity provider, approved reasoning providers, operational service levels and named independent reviewers remain to be confirmed.
intake.currentState: No accepted production SAE baseline is supplied. The target-state hypothesis defines the starting boundary.
intake.duplicateCheck: Use change identity and solution register to check for duplicate or overlapping demand before authorizing an executable contract.

testSelection.method: Classify confirmed intake facts, activate governed rule packs, bind required tests to acceptance criteria, merge owner-requested additional tests, then freeze an independently reviewed Verification Contract.
testSelection.gatePolicy: A failed mandatory test, missing essential execution evidence, unsupported decision-critical claim or unresolved authority decision blocks release. UNKNOWN never becomes PASS by omission; exceptions require named authority, scope and expiry.

testCatalog.title: Build typecheck and lint
testCatalog.procedure: Compile the candidate and apply type and lint checks to supported targets.
testCatalog.acceptance: No build errors, incompatible types or mandatory lint failures.
testCatalog.record: Build constraints satisfied in the reference record.

testCatalog.title: API and schema contracts
testCatalog.procedure: Validate manifest, intake and ReadinessPackageV2 schemas; reject incompatible API changes.
testCatalog.acceptance: Required fields and exact versioned object references remain valid.
testCatalog.record: Compatible schemas; malformed and incompatible payloads rejected.

testCatalog.title: Authorized paths and artifact integrity
testCatalog.procedure: Compare candidate paths with the contract allowlist and verify artifact hashes.
testCatalog.acceptance: No forbidden path changes; package hashes match the assessed revision.
testCatalog.record: Allowed paths preserved; altered artifact rejected.

testCatalog.title: Static application security
testCatalog.procedure: Apply SAST rules to parsers, packet builders, access paths and rendering sinks.
testCatalog.acceptance: No unresolved mandatory injection or unsafe-data-flow findings.
testCatalog.record: Unsafe-path challenge blocked; mandatory checks satisfied.

testCatalog.title: Dependencies and supply chain
testCatalog.procedure: Run dependency and SCA policy checks; inspect the SBOM, supplier restrictions and licenses.
testCatalog.acceptance: No unresolved prohibited dependency, license or critical vulnerability.
testCatalog.record: Dependency inventory and supplier-policy coverage complete.

testCatalog.title: Secrets and configuration
testCatalog.procedure: Scan source and exports for secrets; validate runtime and infrastructure configuration.
testCatalog.acceptance: Credentials absent from source, packet payloads and audit exports; required settings enforced.
testCatalog.record: Secret sentinel excluded; insecure configuration rejected.

testCatalog.title: Source manifests and provenance
testCatalog.procedure: Validate checksums, media types, parse states and provenance on every source record.
testCatalog.acceptance: Malformed or unsupported material is explicit; manifests never become authoritative knowledge.
testCatalog.record: Tampered source rejected; provenance references preserved.

testCatalog.title: Container image scanning
testCatalog.procedure: If a container target is selected, scan the exact image and deployment configuration.
testCatalog.acceptance: Required image checks pass for a confirmed container deployment target.
testCatalog.record: Container target not selected in the intake; reclassification required if it changes.

testCatalog.title: Unit integration and API behavior
testCatalog.procedure: Exercise acquisition, confirmation, package construction and service boundaries.
testCatalog.acceptance: Normal paths produce the expected typed outputs; invalid inputs remain explicit.
testCatalog.record: Expected outputs and invalid-input behavior match acceptance criteria.

testCatalog.title: End to end human confirmed intake
testCatalog.procedure: Follow intake review, confirmation, assessment and consistent export views.
testCatalog.acceptance: Unconfirmed intake cannot start assessment; confirmed snapshot is used everywhere.
testCatalog.record: Early assessment denied; confirmed snapshot retained across views.

testCatalog.title: Negative and adversarial evidence
testCatalog.procedure: Challenge fabricated citations, prompt-like source instructions, unsupported claims and missing proof.
testCatalog.acceptance: Source content cannot override controls or silently satisfy an evidence obligation.
testCatalog.record: Fabricated locator and source-instruction challenge rejected.

testCatalog.title: Authentication and authorization
testCatalog.procedure: Exercise owner, reviewer and approver rights, including unauthorized access attempts.
testCatalog.acceptance: Only the authorized role performs each protected action; denials are attributable.
testCatalog.record: Unauthorized confirmation, evidence access and approval denied.

testCatalog.title: Failure recovery and incomplete execution
testCatalog.procedure: Interrupt parsing and verification, retry safely and test missing essential execution evidence.
testCatalog.acceptance: No false pass after interruption; recovery preserves package identity and UNKNOWN states.
testCatalog.record: Incomplete proof remains UNKNOWN; retry does not duplicate findings.

testCatalog.title: Privacy and provider packet boundary
testCatalog.procedure: Inspect approved summaries, model packets, exports and audit data with raw-data and credential sentinels.
testCatalog.acceptance: Raw files, pixels and secrets stay outside provider packets; minimized fields only.
testCatalog.record: Boundary sentinels excluded; unsupported disclosure blocked.

testCatalog.title: Accessibility
testCatalog.procedure: Check keyboard navigation, focus order, labels, contrast and error announcements.
testCatalog.acceptance: Key intake, findings and review actions are accessible without a pointer.
testCatalog.record: Keyboard paths, focus and readable status announcements satisfy the case.

testCatalog.title: Dynamic security and penetration paths
testCatalog.procedure: Apply DAST and penetration scenarios to parser inputs, session boundaries and protected API routes.
testCatalog.acceptance: No unresolved mandatory exploit path within the confirmed attack surface.
testCatalog.record: Injection and unauthorized-session paths denied in the reference case.

testCatalog.title: Regression differential and instrument coverage
testCatalog.procedure: Compare accepted baseline outputs and coverage across all 180 work items, including unknown cases.
testCatalog.acceptance: No dropped work item or weakened blocker; output differences are attributable.
testCatalog.record: 180 of 180 work items accounted for; blocker behavior preserved. Mutation testing is not mandated by this baseline.

testCatalog.title: Actual versus authorized impact
testCatalog.procedure: Compare candidate changes, API schemas and configuration with the predicted affected-system slice.
testCatalog.acceptance: No material unplanned scope or architecture-invariant change.
testCatalog.record: Observed reference boundary matches the authorized slice.

testCatalog.title: Dependency data flow and permission changes
testCatalog.procedure: Traverse dependencies, access paths, personal-data flows and third-party calls.
testCatalog.acceptance: All affected services and trust boundaries are declared; new impact reopens applicability.
testCatalog.record: Local intake and approved-provider boundaries accounted for; scope stable.

testCatalog.title: Citation revision and semantic support
testCatalog.procedure: Resolve claim locators and source hashes; compare claimed implementation with supporting records.
testCatalog.acceptance: Only supported claims satisfy obligations; mismatched revisions remain unresolved.
testCatalog.record: Fabricated locator rejected; decisive claims bound to exact reference records.

testCatalog.title: Evidence ceilings contradictions and finding lock
testCatalog.procedure: Challenge evidence quality, conflicting sources and incomplete human review before finding lock.
testCatalog.acceptance: No unsupported locked finding; unknowns and evidence ceilings survive synthesis.
testCatalog.record: Conflicting proof withheld from lock; UNKNOWN preserved.

testCatalog.title: Policy enforcement trace
testCatalog.procedure: Traverse authority, applicability, control, contract, enforcement point, evidence, finding and gate.
testCatalog.acceptance: Every active mandatory obligation has a complete exact-ID trace and enforcement evidence.
testCatalog.record: Required trace chains complete; missing-control case blocks readiness.

testCatalog.title: Human authority and exceptions
testCatalog.procedure: Attempt automatic approval and an unscoped exception; check named authority requirements.
testCatalog.acceptance: No automated risk acceptance or release authority; exceptions are scoped and attributable.
testCatalog.record: Automatic approval denied; unsigned or expired exception cannot clear a gate.

testCatalog.title: Assurance scope and materiality
testCatalog.procedure: Evaluate new-build, purpose, trust-boundary and lifecycle triggers against local and expanded scopes.
testCatalog.acceptance: Always review the local change; material triggers require affected-system and whole-solution coverage.
testCatalog.record: All three assurance scopes selected for this new SAE solution.

additionalTests.title: Intake manifests cannot promote themselves into governed knowledge
additionalTests.reason: SAE-specific separation of declared evidence and governing authority is absent from the generic structural pack.
additionalTests.procedure: Submit a manifest claiming to be the normative catalogue and attempt criterion replacement.
additionalTests.acceptance: The catalogue remains unchanged and the manifest stays declared source evidence.

additionalTests.title: High aggregate scores and completed tactics cannot clear blockers
additionalTests.reason: Cross-control interaction between SAE score, exact tactic mapping and finding closure needs a dedicated case.
additionalTests.procedure: Combine a high domain score with a mandatory blocker, then mark a tactic complete without reverification.
additionalTests.acceptance: Readiness remains blocked; tactic completion never closes the finding without new verified proof.
additionalTests.record: High score cannot override blocker; premature closure denied.

additionalTests.title: Publication and exports cannot alter canonical readiness
additionalTests.reason: SAE publication eligibility and canonical view integrity need one combined cross-view regression case.
additionalTests.procedure: Quarantine unsupported prose and compare workspace, summary and export package identities.
additionalTests.acceptance: Publication state is independent; all views retain identical package ID and readiness.
additionalTests.record: Narrative withheld; canonical package and gate decisions unchanged.
